Boundary confirmations identify the actual physical page; another page cannot supply dismissal evidence.
Fitted photo height cannot enlarge its width beyond the text block or its 150ppi source limit; unsupported dimensions use contain.

known_gap_in_prior_audits: Checking embedded image bytes or clipped extraction bounds missed two wide photo strips whose draw rectangles extended beyond the page. Their sides were cropped. Actual image bounds and rendered outer-edge controls now catch this.
